watch.summary: A streamer carefully positions his small bunny prop on a sofa in a hide-and-seek game, only to accidentally ruin his spot by standing up as soon as he finishes.

beats.what: The streamer wonders why his prop keeps twitching and rotating on the sofa.
He tries to straighten up while repeatedly triggering the warning that his body is buried too much.
He finally aligns his prop on the couch and declares he is ready.
He accidentally presses a key and transforms back into his player model, standing up.
He reacts with sarcastic dismay and laughs at his own mistake.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The comedy stems from the contrast between his prolonged, painstaking efforts to align his prop and the instantaneous mistake that ruins it all right as he finishes.
